senses.gloss: श्येन- + जीविन् श्येन- + जीविन्, m. one who lives by training hawks, a falconer, Man. 3, 164.

श्येत श्येत (probably from श्वि in श्वित्, cf. श्वेत and Zend. श्पि in श्पि + तम, श्पि + ति),
 I. adj., f. ता and श्येनी, White, Kir. 5, 31.
 II. m. White (the colour).

श्येन श्येन (akin to the last),
 I. m.
 1. White (the colour).
 2. A hawk, Pañc. 188, 15.
 II. f. नी. A female hawk.
